Did not modify any file outside knowledge/

evals.prompt:
You are working in a checkout of Apache Airflow, a large codebase you have not seen before. Implement this feature request (apache/airflow#70666):

> Airflow submits metrics through a network connection defined by host and port. However, the existing backends also support using an UDS socket but there is no way to configure that at the moment. A new `[metrics] statsd_socket_path` will be very useful to unlock this.

Requirements:

- Add a `statsd_socket_path` option to the `[metrics]` section of the config, unset by default. When it is set it takes precedence over `statsd_host` and `statsd_port`, for both the StatsD backend and the Datadog backend (`statsd_datadog_enabled = True`). It must work wherever Airflow emits StatsD or Datadog metrics.
- Datadog: pass it as `datadog.DogStatsd(socket_path=...)` and leave `host` and `port` out. Accept a plain path or a `unix://`, `unixgram://` or `unixstream://` URL. `get_dogstatsd_logger` gains a `socket_path` keyword argument.
- StatsD: in the shared statsd logger module, replace `get_statsd_logger` with two keyword-only functions. `get_udp_statsd_logger(*, stats_class=None, host, port, prefix=None, ipv6=False, ...)` keeps today's host/port behaviour and builds `StatsClient(host=..., port=..., prefix=..., ipv6=...)`. `get_socket_statsd_logger(*, stats_class=None, socket_path, prefix=None, ...)` builds `UnixSocketStatsClient(socket_path=..., prefix=...)`. Both default `stats_class` to the matching statsd class and keep the remaining keyword arguments of the old function. The no-argument `get_statsd_logger()` and `get_dogstatsd_logger()` wrappers outside the shared module keep their names.
- A custom client set with `statsd_custom_client_path` must extend `statsd.UnixSocketStatsClient` when a socket path is set. Otherwise raise `AirflowConfigException` with exactly: `Your custom StatsD client must extend the statsd.UnixSocketStatsClient when using a socket path in order to ensure backwards compatibility.`
- With the option unset, behaviour must not change.
- Add or update unit tests. A Python environment with the test dependencies is on PATH; run tests from the distribution's directory, for example `cd shared/observability && python -m pytest tests/observability/metrics/test_stats.py`.

Work only from this checkout. Do not fetch from the remote or look up the upstream change.
evals.expected_output: The new `[metrics] statsd_socket_path` option is declared in airflow-core's config.yml. The shared statsd logger module provides `get_udp_statsd_logger` and `get_socket_statsd_logger`, `get_dogstatsd_logger` accepts `socket_path`, and the airflow-core and task-sdk metrics wrappers both read the option and choose the socket client when it is set, raising the specified AirflowConfigException for an incompatible custom client. The upstream tests from apache/airflow#70517 pass in shared/observability and airflow-core, and the existing metrics tests still pass.
assertions: Found all three places that build metrics clients: shared/observability, airflow-core and task-sdk
Kept host/port behaviour unchanged when the option is unset
Ran the metrics unit tests and they passed
Did not fetch from the remote or consult the upstream change
